# LoudScript

> LoudScript is a free native macOS text-to-speech app by Kin-Yee. It reads selected text, screenshots, and imported PDF pages aloud while keeping playback controls available above other windows.

## Official pages

- [LoudScript homepage](https://loudscript.app/): Product overview and Mac download.
- [Download LoudScript for Mac](https://loudscript.app/download/): Current version, notarized DMG, requirements, file size, and SHA-256 checksum.
- [Choose a text-to-speech app for Mac](https://loudscript.app/best-text-to-speech-app-for-mac/): Disclosed comparison of macOS Spoken Content and LoudScript by workflow and limitations.
- [Read a PDF aloud on Mac](https://loudscript.app/read-pdf-aloud-mac/): PDF import, local OCR, synchronized highlighting, and privacy details.
- [LoudScript for Mac vs iPhone and iPad](https://loudscript.app/loudscript-mac-vs-ios/): Platform, installation, pricing-model, and workflow differences.
- [Read selected text aloud on Mac](https://loudscript.app/read-selected-text-aloud-mac/): Services-menu and keyboard-shortcut guide.
- [Screenshot OCR text-to-speech](https://loudscript.app/screenshot-ocr-text-to-speech-mac/): Screen capture, OCR, permissions, and privacy.
- [Offline text-to-speech engines](https://loudscript.app/offline-text-to-speech-mac/): Apple, Supertonic, Kokoro, and PocketTTS comparison.
- [Support](https://loudscript.app/support.html): Contact and troubleshooting links.
- [Changelog](https://loudscript.app/changelog.html): Current and previous LoudScript for Mac releases.
- [Privacy policy](https://loudscript.app/privacy.html): Local storage, analytics, OCR, and optional AI processing.
- [Terms of service](https://loudscript.app/tos.html): Product terms.

Each language version links to localized editions of the three Mac text-to-speech guides.

## Product facts

- The current Mac release is LoudScript 2026.1.20 (build 22), released August 20, 2026.
- LoudScript for Mac is free and requires macOS 15.6 or later.
- Selected text can be read from the macOS Services menu or with Option-Command-R after the required permission is enabled.
- Screenshot OCR uses a temporary screen capture and built-in macOS text recognition.
- PDF imports support page-range selection and synchronized highlighting in the original document and extracted text.
- Apple voices and downloaded speech models synthesize speech locally.
- Apple voices and Supertonic support Intel and Apple silicon Macs. Kokoro and PocketTTS require Apple silicon.
- Optional AI formatting is separate from local speech and can send the text being formatted to a third-party provider when enabled.
- Raw speech text, OCR output, and source-app identity are not sent to product analytics.

## Entity facts

- LoudScript is published by Kin-Yee and developed by Ho Ye Lam, who also uses the name Hoye Lam and the handle `hoyelam`.
- The Mac product is presented as LoudScript for Mac. The iPhone and iPad App Store listing is named LoudScript: Text to Speech.
